subject.title: fix(control-ui): WebSocket connects to wrong gateway when two share an origin

question: Should this PR intentionally treat legacy same-host different-path Gateway URLs as unsafe except for root/current-base `/ws` endpoint shapes, or should it preserve a broader same-origin custom endpoint set before merge?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported wrong-WebSocket target, but the Gateway URL field is user-editable and some legacy same-origin custom values cannot be mechanically distinguished from sibling base-path pollution without a maintainer compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept Current Boundary After Fixture Repair
options.body: Remove the stale test fields and proceed if maintainers agree that non-`/ws` same-host legacy paths should reset to the page-derived gateway.

options.title: Broaden Same-Origin Preservation
options.body: Ask for additional discriminator logic and focused upgrade tests that preserve more intentional same-origin custom endpoint shapes before merge.

options.title: Choose Another Canonical Branch
options.body: Pause this PR only if a sibling implementation becomes cleanly mergeable, proof-positive, and better matches the desired compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Boundary After Fixture Repair
recommendation.body: Remove the stale test fields and proceed if maintainers agree that non-`/ws` same-host legacy paths should reset to the page-derived gateway.
